### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – September 8, 2026

#### Junkrat's Loot Hunt

Junkrat's Loot Hunt goes Legendary, with a specially themed twist! Join Junkrat for a unique yet familiar mixup for three weeks starting September 12 and running until September 29.

#### Hero Updates

#### Tank

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/xXRg/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-01-t.png)

##### D.Mon

> **Developer Comments:** D.Mon has settled into a strong position since launch. We're reducing Call Mech's transformation time to match D.Va's while adjusting Portable Fusion Repeater to improve accuracy and reduce effectiveness at longer distances. We're also reducing Plasma Saber's damage to help offset these improvements.

* Armor reduced from 325 to 300. (6v6)

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/onWi/372X110/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-02-t.png)

Plasma Saber

* Damage reduced from 65 to 60.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/a0uz/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-03-t.png)

Power Barrier

* Cast time decreased from 0.065s to 0.016s.
* Notches on side of shield reduced in size.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/LLAH/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-04-t.png)

Call Mech

* Transformation duration has been reduced from 1.95 to 0.95 seconds.
* A new first-person bootup animation lasting 1 second has been added.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/9tsL/360X123/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-05-t.png)

Portable Fusion Repeater

* Spread reduced from 2 to 1.75 degrees.
* Minimum falloff range reduced from 30 to 20 meters.

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/4Eup/256X256/1f6a7dcd9f35dcd719cb4672fe714610cebb7c13037d1a77a27fb0b1b795ddaa-t.png)

##### D.Va

> **Developer Comments:** We're increasing D.Va's base health to improve her durability without making adjustments to her Defense Matrix.

* Mech base health increased from 175 to 200. (5v5)

![Domina](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/3l5O/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-02-t.png)

##### Domina

> **Developer Comments:** Domina's ultimate is disruptive but not always consequential relative to the time required to earn it. We're reducing its cost to make it available more frequently.

* Ultimate Cost reduced by 6%.

![Mauga](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cI5S/256X256/937cbae13f50502b4191c09b7c178ef60d2eadddcdda5bc4268c1541216b8722-t.png)

##### Mauga

> **Developer Comments:** Mauga continues to have high durability and damage output. We're reverting the spread adjustment made to single-fire Chainguns while reducing the effectiveness of firing both weapons at longer ranges. Alongside his armor reduction, these changes will lower both survivability and lethality.

* Base armor reduced from 150 to 125.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/qcBJ/239X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-06-t.png)

Chainguns

* Maximum spread when firing a single gun reverted from 1.5 to 1 degree.
* Maximum spread when firing both guns increased from 4 to 5 degrees.
* Damage falloff minimum range when firing both guns reduced from 15 to 10 meters.

![Winston](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/ccoM/256X256/75aca7ce9cfb1427afae44f2d1b02dd347fdcb4355c6d030da55e40b0230bf92-t.png)

##### Winston

> **Developer Comments:** Winston's Barrier Projector cooldown is being reduced to shorten the downtime between engagements. To offset the increased availability, its duration is also being reduced.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/61nK/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-41-t.png)

Barrier Projector

* Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds. (5v5)
* Duration reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

![wrecking Ball](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/wAya/256X256/ba90526d1d04df32560cc663a5df5a61b601492922336b4cbbda10572c3a6900-t.png)

##### wrecking Ball

> **Developer Comments:** Adaptive Barrier has provided Wrecking Ball with too long a protection window. We're reducing its duration to place greater emphasis on timing its use.

Adaptive Barrier – Major Perk

* Duration reduced from 1.5 to 1 second.

![Zarya](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/skCy/256X256/bdc3fb8aa2c87debc3d4565197b969c5c7b4f0c9059dd8ad3335c8e536a91e0f-t.png)

##### Zarya

> **Developer Comments:** The cooldown of Particle Barrier is being increased to reduce Zarya's personal barrier uptime and energy generation. Projected Barrier remains unchanged, encouraging more proactive use on allies.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/AD82/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-14-t.png)

Particle Barrier

* Cooldown increased from 11 to 12 seconds. (5v5)

#### Damage

![Anran](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/qF45/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-11-t.png)

##### Anran

> **Developer Comments:** Dancing Blaze can generate significant visual clutter, making Anran difficult to track during combat. We're removing the visual clones visible to opponents to improve clarity. Vermillion Revival's cast time is also being reduced to shorten the window opponents have to react.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/jUOn/128X128/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-13-t.png)

Dancing Blaze

* Reduced the amount of visual effects enemies see when impacted by Dancing Blaze.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/CgXQ/128X128/9060d9e2e407a31ab95948e6512373a4318ebd8883aefa91e9f2fa9bbffb7076-t.png)

Vermillion Revival

* Cast time reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds.

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/gboy/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-63-t.png)

##### Freja

> **Developer Comments:** Recent changes have significantly increased Freja's damage output. We're reducing the damage of both Revdraw Crossbow and Take Aim, while also lowering the effectiveness of Relentless Barrage. Explosive Bolt's impact sound effects have also been reduced to lessen audio clutter when repeatedly hit.

Relentless Barrage – Minor Perk

* Refunded automatic bolts reduced from 8 to 5.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/00Na/251X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-13-t.png)

Revdraw Crossbow

* Damage reduced from 30 to 28.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zTnk/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-67-t.png)

Take Aim

* Explosive Bolt explosion damage reduced from 80 to 75.
* Explosive bolt impact sound effects reduced.

![Junkrat](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/5VCF/256X256/f807df911fec53e9c86107affc4d7a5c08612ae0de1baafe7c12352a048b9b52-t.png)

##### Junkrat

> **Developer Comments:** Junkrat has struggled to remain effective since the weakening of his Concussion Mine combo. We're reducing Concussion Mine's cooldown to increase both damage output and mobility. Nitro Boost's movement speed bonus is also being reduced to limit the high speeds of the ultimate with the perk equipped.

Nitro Boost – Minor Perk

* Bonus speed reduced from 125% to 100%.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/kGs1/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-81-t.png)

Concussion Mine

* Cooldown reduced from 8 to 7 seconds.

![Sierra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/P2Fo/256X256/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-01-t.png)

##### Sierra

> **Developer Comments:** Sierra's damage output has remained high since release, but her weapon reliability has been limited by projectile travel time at longer ranges. We're reducing the damage of both Helix Rifle and Tracking Shot while increasing projectile speed to improve weapon responsiveness and consistency. Tremor Charge's cooldown is also being reduced to make it available more frequently.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tFnn/388X103/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-03-t.png)

Helix Rifle

* Weapon projectile speed increased from 90 to 120.
* Damage reduced from 9 to 8.5.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/K2fe/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-04-t.png)

Tracking Shot

* Damage reduced from 9 to 8.5.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/VYXd/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-26-t.png)

Tremor Charge

* Cooldown reduced from 8.5 to 7 seconds.

![Symmetra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/oNvX/256X256/a2c620d948703d0ac5e6ee3dc30fda346b0c1644aa5b318e4c78f9feebf89b68-t.png)

##### Symmetra

> **Developer Comments:** Symmetra's Teleporter can be extremely effective in coordinated teams, enabling long-distance repositioning with limited opportunities for opponents to respond. We're reducing its placement range to limit how far teams can travel with it, while increasing the reuse cooldown to make Teleporter use a greater commitment.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/enir/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-28-t.png)

Teleporter

* Placement range reduced from 30 to 25 meters.
* Teleport reuse cooldown increased from 1 to 1.25 seconds.

![Torbjörn](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/nXs8/256X256/b1b376c95ed7f017b9be712c9069305c7e5cb26b010aa988697805ffa1cc20a5-t.png)

##### Torbjörn

> **Developer Comments:** Torbjörn's secondary fire is being improved to increase its consistency at closer ranges. We're also reducing Anchor Bolts' turret throw range to preserve the perk's flexibility while limiting extremely distant turret placements.

Anchor Bolts – Major Perk

* Deploy turrets increased throw range reduced from 50% to 25%.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/TlFs/220X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-30-t.png)

Rivet Gun

* Secondary fire spread reduced from 4.5 to 4 degrees.

![Vendetta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/iADD/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-31-t.png)

##### Vendetta

> **Developer Comments:** These changes are intended to improve the responsiveness of Vendetta's primary fire without significantly increasing the speed of her overall combo. We've reduced delays within Palatine Fang while increasing the recovery times of Whirlwind Dash and Sundering Blade to preserve overall pacing.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/3x4g/354X108/9754a770516c07712b3cbababb825972eec78c08b3fbc141dbcee31d9c58c137-t.png)

Palatine Fang

* Initial Swing delay reduced from 0.3 to 0.15 seconds.
* Horizontal swing duration reduced from 0.25 to 0.2 seconds.
* Combo link duration increased from 0.75 to 0.9 seconds.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/HYT7/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-116-t.png)

Whirlwind Dash

* Recovery increased from 0.5 to 0.75 seconds.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ZNYc/128X128/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-32-t.png)

Sundering Blade

* Recovery increased from 0.2 to 0.5 seconds.
* Camera pitch is no longer fully locked during the slash.

![Widowmaker](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/prRT/256X256/170aeb0ae3da053cbfd3b7db386db88a904745d692361a006048928cc9a1990a-t.png)

##### Widowmaker

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/PZlP/128X128/d1a1ab39ce64160b3bd5473ad5ece8115648580158514c006c9ba1398e9a8d49-t.png)

Take Aim

* Updated Widowmaker's Take Aim charge sound effects for the default, Mythic, and Hello Kitty weapons. These sound effects now increase in intensity when the charge level is above 50%.

#### Support

![Baptiste](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/vyOn/256X256/9e172616c22eb48adc116ccae7520270da9b59252f2d35d00ca6ac74af481248-t.png)

##### Baptiste

> **Developer Comments:** Immortality Field's long cooldown and vulnerability to being destroyed can limit its effectiveness. We're increasing its health, lowering its cooldown, and raising its minimum health threshold to improve its overall reliability.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/JNOB/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-131-t.png)

Immortality Field

* Unkillable health threshold increased from 20% to 25%.
* Cooldown reduced from 22 to 20 seconds.
* Health increased from 125 to 150.

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/zUCN/256X256/dbc7d49f32020fed1033cb4bb99b55f7938d1a71108fe76edc589e42c8cd0977-t.png)

##### Brigitte

> **Developer Comments:** Brigitte's durability can be limited due to operating at close range. We're shifting a portion of her health into armor to improve survivability.

* Health reduced from 200 to 175.
* Armor increased from 50 to 75.

![Jetpack Cat](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ZnC1/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-37-t.png)

##### Jetpack Cat

> **Developer Comments:** Recent movement changes have significantly improved Jetpack Cat's mobility and overall effectiveness. We're reducing the damage and healing of Biotic Pawjectiles to lower overall output. Lifeline is also being adjusted to provide additional counterplay against carried targets while improving its reliability when rescuing allies from environmental deaths.

* Increased sound priority and volume of base movement and Frenetic Flight.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/6kfb/253X128/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-39-t.png)

Biotic Pawjectiles

* Damage and healing per projectile reduced from 4.5 to 4.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cu9l/128X128/d0c899ac61aa5b72e7de931b014b02176605fba7c9f022cc7a968b6cc6ebf19b-t.png)

Lifeline

* Stuns and mobility locking effects on a carried target now disconnect Lifeline.
* Allies now automatically accept Lifeline when over a death plane.

![Kiriko](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)

##### Kiriko

> **Developer Comments:** Kiriko has become highly effective as a healer while retaining the utility and mobility of her kit. We're reducing the speed and range of Healing Ofuda to lower her healing consistency at longer distances. Protection Suzu is also being adjusted to reduce the effectiveness of its invulnerability and require more precise use.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/PmZ5/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-147-t.png)

Healing Ofuda

* Projectile travel speed reduced from 24 to 18 meters per second.
* Maximum seeking range reduced from 35 to 30 meters.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6tMN/128X128/patch-2026-05-12-4b3a5430c9-26-t.png)

Protection Suzu

* Phased out invulnerability duration reduced from 0.65 to 0.5 seconds.
* Explosion radius reduced from 5 to 4 meters.

![Wuyang](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/fPiL/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-50-t.png)

##### Wuyang

> **Developer Comments:** Wuyang's empowered healing resource can be limiting when responding to sustained damage. We're increasing its regeneration rate to provide more frequent access to empowered healing.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20260911/xuof/256X256/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-47.png)

Restorative Stream

* Regeneration rate increased from 12.5% to 15% per second.
* Line of sight timeout reduced from 5 to 3 seconds.

![Zenyatta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Zqgs/256X256/58a05fe509b6b5333a4e3bf761afab6493420bf58fa2fac834ca1d3f779961d2-t.png)

##### Zenyatta

> **Developer Comments:** Harmony Orb can remain active on targets for extended periods with minimal upkeep. We're reducing its line-of-sight grace period to place greater emphasis on maintaining awareness of orb targets and repositioning it when needed.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/tnTz/128X128/c8e37e2f3e147fde823bb9566b57e3e20d238430f0cb4f8aa8b581525a4f225e-t.png)

Harmony Orb

* Line of sight timeout reduced from 5 to 3 seconds.

#### Stadium Updates

#### Tank

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/4Eup/256X256/1f6a7dcd9f35dcd719cb4672fe714610cebb7c13037d1a77a27fb0b1b795ddaa-t.png)

##### D.Va

**MEKA Ejector - Power**

* Ultimate Charge cost reduction increased to 60% (Up from 50%).

![Junker Queen](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### Junker Queen

**Cut 'Em Gracie - Power**

* Return damage reduced to 30 (Down from 40).

#### Damage

![Genji](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Vvnx/256X256/9bff8d12c9ffa4de593c1d2e6a09f674fa42493b1ae636c9685d790100f96d20-t.png)

##### Genji

**Laceration - Power**

* Cooldown reduction per target increased to 2.5s (Up from 2s).

![Vendetta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/iADD/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-31-t.png)

##### Vendetta

**Apex Bloodlust - Power**

* Lifesteal per stack reduced to 4% (Down from 5%).

#### Support

![Ana](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FfFC/256X256/3c87d470067d61c432815a4bc0c70b11f1b5379006da29625839da356b7c4ca1-t.png)

##### Ana

**Falconer - Power**

* Attack speed bonus increased to 50% (Up from 30%).
* Ultimate Charge gain reduced to 10% (Down from 25%).

![Jetpack Cat](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ZnC1/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-37-t.png)

##### Jetpack Cat

**Territorial - Power**

* Damage reduced to 20% of healing (Down from 30%).

#### Bug Fixes

General

* Fixed a bug where Battlepass XP was not granted for Stadium Quick Play Matches.
* Fixed a bug with the "Solus Victorem 2026 Finals" Spray.
* Fixed a bug where the kill feed would sometimes be out of order.
* Fixed several issues with the After Match Rewards summary.
* Fixed several issues with the ping system.
* Removed the High Precision Mouse Input setting, as the problem it was built to solve has now been addressed through other means. The setting's removal does not change how mouse input functions in-game.

Heroes

**Mercy**

* Fixed an issue causing Mercy's Flash Heal ability to not be counted for the "Support Ability Mastery" or "Master of Life and Death" daily challenges.

**D.Mon**

* Fixed an issue with the "Toggle Boosters" setting.

Maps

* Fixed a bug with the Black Forest map. It is now re-enabled.

Stadium

* Fixed an issue where Mercy's Sympathetic Recovery passive wasn't properly working in Stadium.
* Fixed an issue where Cut 'Em Gracie would sometimes pull targets not stuck by the blade.

#### “狂鼠”的补给狩猎

“狂鼠”的补给狩猎升级为传说级别，并带来了特别的主题变数！9月12日起至9月29日，加入“狂鼠”，在为期三周的活动中体验独特又熟悉的混合玩法。

#### 英雄更新

#### 重装

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/xXRg/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-01-t.png)

##### D.Mon

> **开发者评论：**D.Mon自上线以来一直处于强势地位。我们将“呼叫机甲”的变形时间缩短至与D.Va一致，同时调整了“手提聚变连发枪”，以提高其精准度并降低其在远距离的效能。我们还降低了“等离子剑”的伤害，以平衡这些增强。

* 护甲从325减少至300。（6v6）

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/onWi/372X110/patch-2026-08-12-97bf4d7039-02-t.png)

等离子剑

* 伤害从65减少至60。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/a0uz/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-03-t.png)

强力屏障

* 施放时间从0.065秒减少至0.016秒。
* 护盾侧面的凹槽尺寸缩小。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/LLAH/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-04-t.png)

呼叫机甲

* 变形持续时间从1.95秒减少至0.95秒。
* 添加了持续1秒的全新第一人称启动动画。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/9tsL/360X123/patch-2026-09-09-b307815e90-05-t.png)

手提聚变连发枪

* 扩散范围从2度减少至1.75度。
* 伤害衰减的最小距离从30米减少至20米。

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/4Eup/256X256/1f6a7dcd9f35dcd719cb4672fe714610cebb7c13037d1a77a27fb0b1b795ddaa-t.png)

##### D.Va

> **开发者评论：**我们增加了D.Va的基础生命值，以在不调整“防御矩阵”的情况下提升她的生存能力。

* 机甲基础生命值从175增加至200。（5v5）

![金驭](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/3l5O/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-02-t.png)

##### 金驭

> **开发者评论：**金驭的终极技能具有破坏性，但相对于充能所需的时间而言，其效果并不总是那么显著。我们降低了它的消耗，使其能更频繁地使用。

* 终极技能消耗减少6%。

![毛加](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cI5S/256X256/937cbae13f50502b4191c09b7c178ef60d2eadddcdda5bc4268c1541216b8722-t.png)

##### 毛加

> **开发者评论：**毛加依然拥有极高的生存能力和输出能力。我们回调了单发“链式步枪”的扩散调整，同时降低了在较远距离同时开火的效能。配合护甲的减少，这些改动将降低他的生存能力和杀伤力。

* 基础护甲从150减少至125。

### 《守望先锋》补丁说明——2026年9月9日

#### “狂鼠”的补给狩猎

“狂鼠”的补给狩猎即将书写传奇，还将呈献特殊的主题反转！从9月13日至9月30日，和“狂鼠”一起在这三周里掀起一场独一无二而又熟悉万分的玩法混搭吧！

#### 英雄更新

#### 重装

![D.Mon](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/a2T3/256X256/patch-2026-08-15-0871125153-01.png)

##### D.Mon

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：自推出以来，D.Mon已经在游戏的生态里占据了牢固的位置。我们决定削弱“呼叫机甲”的变形时间，使其与D.Va的同类技能处于同一水平，同时也调整了“手提聚变连发枪”，提高了命中率，并削弱了长距离的威力。为了平衡这些优化，我们还削弱了“等离子剑”的伤害。

* 护甲从325点降低至300点。（6v6）

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/0B6r/372X110/patch-2026-08-13-a8662025d2-02.png)

等离子剑

* 伤害从65点降低至60点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/X7h9/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-03.png)

强力屏障

* 施放时间从0.065秒缩短至0.016秒。
* 盾牌侧面的缺口尺寸缩小。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/T2BW/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-04.png)

呼叫机甲

* 变形时间从1.95秒缩短至0.95秒。
* 添加了一个持续1秒的第一人称机甲启动动画。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/mg3s/360X123/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-05.png)

手提聚变连发枪

* 散布角度从2度减少至1.75度。
* 最小衰减距离从30米缩短至20米。

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/y7ki/256X256/patch-2026-03-11-c6717e8e70-01.png)

##### D.Va

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：我们决定提升D.Va的基础生命值，进而增强她的持久能力，同时又不必对她的“防御矩阵”做出调整。

* 机甲的基础生命值从175点提高至200点。（5v5）

![金驭](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/jegH/256X256/patch-2026-07-31-18fb08f17f-01.png)

##### 金驭

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：“金驭”的终极技能具有很强的干扰性，但与积攒终极技能充能所需的时间相比却显得效力不足。我们决定减低它的消耗，从而提高使用频率。

* 终极技能消耗降低6%。

![毛加](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/TMwT/256X256/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-12.png)

##### 毛加

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：毛加依然拥有极高的生存能力和高伤害。我们决定回退之前对单把链式步枪做出的散布调整，并削弱在远距离上同时射击两把链式步枪的威力。再配合对他护甲的削弱，这些改动一同降低了他的生存能力和杀伤力。

* 基础护甲从150点降低至125点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/jBjg/239X128/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-06.png)

链式步枪

* 射击单把链式步枪的最大散布角度从1.5度减少至1度。
* 同时射击两把链式步枪的最大散布角度从4度增加至5度。
* 同时射击两把链式步枪的最小伤害衰减距离从15米缩短至10米。

![温斯顿](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/db3W/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-09.png)

##### 温斯顿

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：我们缩短了温斯顿的“屏障发射器”的冷却时间，进而缩短他每次接战的间隔时间。为了抵消这次接战频率的增强，我们还缩短了它的持续时间。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/akgH/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-41.png)

屏障发射器

* 冷却时间从12秒缩短至10秒。（5v5）
* 持续时间从8秒缩短至7秒。

![破坏球](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/e1sS/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-11.png)

##### 破坏球

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：“感应屏障”为“破坏球”提供了太长的防护时间。我们决定削弱它的持续时间，进而要求玩家更精准地把握使用该技能的时机。

感应屏障——主要威能

* 最大持续时间从1.5秒缩短至1秒。

![查莉娅](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/TlzH/256X256/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-33.png)

##### 查莉娅

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：为了削弱查莉娅个人屏障的可用时间和能量生成率，我们延长了“粒子屏障”的冷却时间。“投射屏障”未做改变，进而鼓励玩家多多使用该技能保护盟友。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/axb6/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-14.png)

粒子屏障

* 冷却时间从11秒延长至12秒。（5v5）

#### 输出

![安燃](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/gQeJ/256X256/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-15.png)

##### 安燃

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：“熠闪舞”可能会造成较为严重的视觉干扰，导致玩家难以在激烈战斗中追踪安燃的行动。为了提升清晰度，我们移除了可见的视觉分身。我们还缩短了“朱魂返”的施放时间，从而削减短对手的反应时间。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/XMkW/128X128/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-15.png)

熠闪舞

* 减少了敌人被“熠闪舞”击中时会看见的视觉特效数量。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/39OA/128X128/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-37.png)

朱魂返

* 施放时间从3秒缩短至2.5秒。

![弗蕾娅](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Ec4S/256X256/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-12.png)

##### 弗蕾娅

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：最近的改动大幅提升了弗蕾娅的伤害输出能力。我们决定削弱“速射弩”和“瞄准射击”的伤害，同时降低“无情弹幕”的威力。为了减轻被反复击中时的音频干扰，我们也减少了“爆炸弩箭”的击中音效。

无情弹幕——次级威能

* 返还的自动弩箭数量从8发减少至5发。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/szo0/251X128/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-13.png)

速射弩

* 伤害从30点降低至28点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/2mih/128X128/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-14.png)

瞄准射击

* “爆炸弩箭”的爆炸伤害从80点降低至75点。
* “爆炸弩箭”击中音效减少。

![狂鼠](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/RPvk/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-22.png)

##### 狂鼠

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：自从“震荡地雷”连招被削弱之后，“狂鼠”一直难以保持足够的战斗力。我们决定缩短“震荡地雷”的冷却时间，进而提升伤害输出能力和机动性。为了限制装备“氮气推进”威能时终极技能提供的极高速度，我们也削弱了这个威能的移动速度加成。

氮气推进——次级威能

* 速度加成从125%降低至100%。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/XqGR/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-81.png)

震荡地雷

* 冷却时间从8秒缩短至7秒。

![西拉](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/axUw/256X256/patch-2026-05-13-dcb0562547-18.png)

##### 西拉

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：自从上线以来，西拉的伤害输出能力一直处于高值，但在远距离上，她的子弹飞行时间又比较长，进而限制了她的武器可靠性。我们决定削弱“螺旋步枪”和“追踪弹”的伤害，并提高弹道速度，进而强化武器的响应灵敏度和稳定度。我们还缩短了“震地手雷”的冷却时间，使其能够更频繁地使用。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Eb1d/388X103/patch-2026-05-13-dcb0562547-19.png)

螺旋步枪

* 武器弹道速度从90米每秒提高至120米每秒。
* 伤害从9点降低至8.5点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/yngx/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-91.png)

追踪弹

* 伤害从9点降低至8.5点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/YT8z/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-26.png)

震地手雷

* 冷却时间从8.5秒缩短至7秒。

![秩序之光](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/lcrh/256X256/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-74.png)

##### 秩序之光

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：在配合默契的队伍中，“秩序之光”的“传送面板”能够发挥极大的作用，使得远距离高效走位变得可能，而且没给对手留下多少反应的机会。我们决定缩小它的放置范围，限制队伍可以使用它来移动的距离，同时还延长了重复使用它进行传送的冷却时间，让玩家在使用“传送面板”时需要投入更多的时间和努力。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/v4TT/128X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-28.png)

传送面板

* 放置范围从30米减少至25米。
* 重复使用它进行传送的冷却时间从1秒延长至1.25秒。

![托比昂](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/hXwo/256X256/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-76.png)

##### 托比昂

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：为了提升近距离上的稳定性，我们决定增强托比昂的辅助攻击模式。为了保留这个威能的灵活性，同时避免出现将炮台放置在极远距离的情况，我们决定缩短“锚固螺栓”的炮台投掷距离。

锚固螺栓——主要威能

* 部署炮台时的投掷距离加成从50%降低至25%。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/8cSK/220X128/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-30.png)

铆钉枪

* 辅助攻击模式的散布从4.5度降低至4度。

![斩仇](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FPth/256X256/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-22.png)

##### 斩仇

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：这次的改动主要是为了优化“斩仇”的主要攻击模式的响应速度，同时又不用明显提高她的整体连招的节奏。为了保持总体操作节奏，我们缩短了“帕拉蒂尼之牙”每一击的延迟时间，并延长了“旋风疾步”和“斩地巨剑”的恢复时间。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tawG/354X108/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-34.png)

帕拉蒂尼之牙

* 第一次挥击的延迟时间从0.3秒缩短至0.15秒。
* 水平挥击的持续时间从0.25秒缩短至0.2秒。
* 连招的衔接动作持续时间从0.75秒延长至0.9秒。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/zJ2o/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-116.png)

旋风疾步

* 恢复时间从0.5秒延长至0.75秒。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/ntJv/128X128/patch-2026-06-17-5d9f1794b9-32.png)

斩地巨剑

* 恢复时间从0.2秒延长到0.5秒。
* 斩击期间，镜头高度不再是完全锁定的。

#### 支援

![巴蒂斯特](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/tGw3/256X256/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-87.png)

##### 巴蒂斯特

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：“维生力场”冷却时间较长，且容易被摧毁，限制了它的发挥。我们决定提升其生命值，缩短其冷却时间，并提升其最低生命值阈值，增强了它的总体可靠性。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/K1re/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-131.png)

维生力场

* 无法消灭的生命值阈值从20%提高至25%。
* 冷却时间从22秒缩短至20秒。
* 生命值从125点提高至150点。

![布丽吉塔](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/te5J/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-38.png)

##### 布丽吉塔

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：在近距离作战时，布丽吉塔的生存能力受到极大限制。为了强化生存能力，我们决定将她的一部分生命值转化为护甲。

* 生命值从200点降低至175点。
* 护甲从50点提升至75点。

![飞天猫](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/3AhW/256X256/patch-2026-08-12-076264163b-23.png)

##### 飞天猫

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：最近对“飞天猫”移动方式的改动大幅增强了其的机动性和整体实力。为了降低整体输出能力，我们还削弱了“生物猫爪弹”的伤害量和治疗量。此外，为了提供更多针对被运载目标的反制方式，以及增强她挽救盟友免于地形阵亡时的可靠性，我们也对“救生索”进行了调整。

* 提升了基础移动和“咻咻飞”的音效优先级和音量。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/1aky/253X128/patch-2026-06-17-5d9f1794b9-39.png)

生物猫爪弹

* 每发射弹的伤害量和治疗量从4.5点降低至4点。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/gIiE/128X128/patch-2026-04-01-dff13fa5ae-94.png)

救生索

* 运载目标受到击晕效果和移动封锁效果时，“救生索”会被切断。
* 现在当处于阵亡地形时，盟友会自动接受“救生索”。

![雾子](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/fvl6/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-51.png)

##### 雾子

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：雾子作为治疗者的能力变得极强，技能的功能性和机动力也一点不差。为了削弱她在远距离上的治疗稳定性，我们决定削弱“符”的速度和范围。我们也对“铃”进行了调整，削弱了无敌效果，希望玩家能更精准地使用此技能。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/DQK0/128X128/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-53.png)

符

* 弹道速度从每秒24米降低至18米。
* 最大追踪距离从35米缩短至30米。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/n8GR/128X128/patch-2026-05-13-dcb0562547-26.png)

铃

* 相移无敌持续时间从0.65秒缩短至0.5秒。
* 爆炸半径从5米缩小至4米。

![无漾](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cZxL/256X256/patch-2026-07-15-4e996155dd-44.png)

##### 无漾

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：在应对持续伤害时，无漾的强化治疗手段和效果有限。我们决定提升它的恢复速度，进而提高强化治疗的使用频率。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yhgk/256X256/patch-2026-09-09-7644523e35-45.png)

养神泉

* 恢复速度从每秒12.5%提高至15%。
* 视野超时时间从5秒缩短至3秒。

![禅雅塔](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/nFcr/256X256/patch-2026-04-15-f92b6e9885-64.png)

##### 禅雅塔

> **开发者评论：** 设计师观点：“谐”可以在目标身上持续较长时间，同时维持消耗又非常低。我们决定缩短它的视野宽限时间，进而要求玩家更重视保持对“谐”目标的观察，在必要时调整走位。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/7qFt/128X128/patch-2026-07-01-1d6c904f0b-171.png)

谐

* 视野超时时间从5秒缩短至3秒。

#### 角斗领域更新

#### 重装

![D.Va](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/y7ki/256X256/patch-2026-03-11-c6717e8e70-01.png)

##### D.Va
